model_interpretation.claim: The catalog has two distinct valid T1 programs: the coalesced one-output-per-thread control averaged 0.0234084 s, while the 16x32-output, K-depth-32 tile averaged 0.0228994 s. That small observed difference does not establish a tiling benefit. This contrasting 8x32-output, K-depth-16 tile keeps a full warp on contiguous output columns while using 256 threads per CTA; it tests whether a smaller row tile and CTA help occupancy, against the costs of less row reuse and more K-loop synchronization. Correctness and repeated timing remain for the controller to evaluate.
